cluster_reason: FastDateFormat, FastDateParser and FastDatePrinter form a cohesive formatting/parsing cluster: FastDateFormat delegates to the parser and printer and has direct internal references to both. Moving them together keeps package-private interactions internal to the cluster and isolates formatting logic from other time utilities (TimeZones, CalendarUtils, etc.), minimizing cross-package visibility changes.

blocks.goal: Move the FastDate* formatting/parsing cluster into a dedicated subpackage to reduce god-component responsibilities.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage if it does not exist.
Move FastDateFormat to the destination package alongside its related parser and printer.
Move FastDateParser together with FastDateFormat and FastDatePrinter to keep parser/formatter internals colocated.
Move FastDatePrinter to the new subpackage so printing helpers remain with the formatter and parser.
